# Crate `lune_ui_winit`

[API reference](../INDEX.md)

winit adapter of the glass UI toolkit: the glass window attributes and the resize edge → winit
direction mapping ([`window`](window.md)), and the translation of winit events into the core's `RawInput`
and the application of its `FrameOutput` ([`input`](input.md)), the OS clipboard ([`clipboard`](clipboard.md)) and,
behind the `accesskit` feature, the bridge to the OS accessibility API (`access`). The app owns
the event loop and calls these from it.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-winit/src/lib.rs:1`

## Modules

- [`window`](window.md) - Window helpers on winit: the glass window attributes and the resize edge → winit mapping.
